canonical_data: Neo4j property graph: per-session conversations, entities with preferences and facts, and reasoning traces with audit edges
strengths: Property graph with explicit audit edges from reasoning steps to entities
Python and TypeScript SDKs held to one model by a conformance suite
Sixteen MCP tools with read-only Cypher and session strategies
Adopts an existing Neo4j graph as long-term memory with consolidation primitives
weaknesses: Labs beta with no SLAs and no backwards-compatibility guarantees
MCP endpoint ships without authentication, for private networks only
Method shapes differ between Bolt and NAMS backends with documented limitations
Requires a user-run Neo4j 5.26 or newer plus client-side model keys
why_it_matters: The only agent memory that stores knowledge as a Neo4j property graph with audit-trailed reasoning, reachable from Python and TypeScript through the same memory model.
